svg.title: Azure platform topology and supporting facilities
svg.desc: Application Gateway WAF_v2 public HTTPS and AKS use separate subnets in workshop VNet 10.30.0.0/16. AKS Cilium Overlay pods use 10.244.0.0/16, separate from the node subnet. Fixed system nodes and managed NAP bounded lab capacity host workloads. Private endpoints in a separate subnet connect to infrastructure Key Vault and Storage, not inferred Store dependencies. Managed observability is outside the VNet boundary. Dashed paths are supporting relationships, not measured traffic.
